overview: 本期共收录 4 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融科技（2 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）、金融经济学（1 篇）。方法上以回归分析为主。来源分布：Semantic Scholar（4 篇）。

papers.title: The Impact of Digital Finance on High-Tech Enterprise Value
papers.venue: Highlights in Business, Economics and Management
papers.abstract: As an innovative financial model, digital finance seamlessly integrates the internet and cutting-edge information technologies with traditional financial services, thereby opening a new chapter in the financial sector. Innovation is the key driver of development; therefore, the steady growth of high-tech enterprises—which are innovation-driven—serves as a vital foundation for achieving high-quality economic development in China. Given that high-tech enterprises are characterized by long investment cycles and high levels of risk, stable and sustained financial support is particularly crucial. Based on the market efficiency hypothesis, financial intermediation, information asymmetry, and transaction cost theory, this study examines listed high-tech enterprises from 2011 to 2020. It constructs fixed-effects and mediation models to conduct an empirical analysis of the impact of digital finance on the value of high-tech enterprises and further employs a series of robustness tests to ensure the accuracy of the results. Based on the empirical results, the study concludes that digital finance promotes the value enhancement of high-tech enterprises; digital finance influences technological innovation, thereby enhancing enterprise value; and there are differences in the promotional effect of digital finance on the value of high-tech enterprises between China’s eastern regions and its central and western regions. Based on these findings, the study proposes corresponding policy recommendations: to continue advancing the development of digital finance; to emphasize the role of technological innovation in enterprise growth and economic development; and to prioritize the coordinated development of digital finance across different regions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】作为一种创新的金融模式，数字金融将互联网和尖端信息技术与传统金融服务无缝结合，从而为金融行业开启了新的篇章。创新是发展的关键驱动力；因此，以创新为核心的高科技企业的稳步增长，为中国实现高质量经济发展奠定了重要基础。鉴于高科技企业具有较长的投资周期和较高的风险水平，稳定而持续的金融支持尤为重要。本研究基于市场效率假说、金融中介作用、信息不对称理论以及交易成本理论，分析了2011年至2020年间上市的高科技企业。通过构建固定效应模型和中介效应模型，对数字金融对高科技企业价值的影响进行了实证研究，并通过一系列稳健性检验来确保研究结果的准确性。实证结果表明：数字金融有助于提升高科技企业的价值；数字金融通过促进技术创新进而增强企业价值；同时，数字金融对中国东部地区与中西部地区的高科技企业价值提升作用存在差异。基于这些发现，研究提出了相应的政策建议：继续推动数字金融的发展；强调技术创新在企业发展与经济增长中的作用；以及优先考虑不同地区数字金融的协调发展。。

papers.title: Carbon Border Adjustment at the Definitive Stage: Exposure Channels, Domestic Carbon Pricing and Green Finance Architecture in Azerbaijan
papers.abstract: The European Union’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) entered its definitive phase on 1 January 2026, converting an instrument of climate policy into an operative condition of market access. This paper examines what that transition means for a small, hydrocarbon-dependent open economy that is simultaneously attempting to diversify its industrial exports and to position itself as a supplier of renewable electricity to the European market. Using documentary analysis of the CBAM legal framework together with scenario-based sensitivity estimates, the study maps Azerbaijan’s exposure across four transmission channels: products already within scope (aluminium, iron and steel, fertilisers), electricity exports planned through the Black Sea submarine interconnector, transit and supply-chain effects associated with the Trans-Caspian corridor, and the prospective downstream extension of the mechanism from 2028. Three findings emerge. First, the financial burden of 2026 is negligible because only 2.5 per cent of embedded emissions attract a certificate obligation in the first year; the binding constraint is instead the absence of verified installation-level emissions data, which triggers conservative country-specific default values carrying a mark-up that rises from 10 per cent in 2026 to 30 per cent in 2028. Second, because a documented domestic carbon price is deductible from the CBAM liability, the policy question is not whether the carbon cost is paid but to whose budget it accrues; the paper shows, however, that this rent-capture logic only becomes fiscally advantageous once the phase-in factor is high, and quantifies the threshold. Third, drawing on recent panel evidence, the paper argues that the binding constraint on green investment in Azerbaijan is the architecture of green finance rather than the volume of fiscal expenditure. An eight-point policy framework and a sequencing timetable are proposed.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】欧盟的碳边境调节机制（CBAM）于2026年1月1日正式进入实施阶段，这一气候政策工具由此转变为市场准入的实际约束条件。本文探讨了这一转变对阿塞拜疆这一小型、依赖碳氢化合物的经济体的影响。阿塞拜疆同时致力于实现工业出口多元化，并试图成为向欧洲市场供应可再生能源电力的国家。通过分析CBAM的法律框架并基于不同情景进行敏感性评估，本文研究了阿塞拜疆在四个方面的受影响程度：已纳入机制范围的产品（铝、钢铁、化肥）、计划通过黑海海底输电线路出口的电力、与跨里海走廊相关的运输和供应链效应，以及该机制从2028年起可能向下游地区的扩展。研究得出以下三个主要结论：首先，2026年的财务负担微不足道，因为仅2.5%的隐含排放量需要缴纳证书费用；真正的制约因素是缺乏经过核实的设施级排放数据，这导致各国采用保守的默认值，相关费用比例从2026年的10%上升至2028年的30%。其次，由于国内碳价可以在CBAM责任中予以抵扣，政策的核心问题不在于碳成本是否实际支付，而在于这些成本最终计入哪个国家的预算；不过研究表明，这种“租金捕获”机制只有在实施力度较大时才具有财政优势，并且本文量化了这一临界点。第三，...。

papers.title: Strategic Financing of Energy Efficiency Solutions in Saudi Arabia’s Power Generation Sector: An Investment Framework for Vision 2030
papers.venue: Global academic journal of economics and business
papers.abstract: Saudi Arabia’s electricity system is undergoing a capital-intensive transition, in which efficiency improvements at existing and new generating assets must compete for funding with renewables, grids, storage, and gas infrastructure. This review explores how financing design is able to transform technically credible energy-efficiency opportunities in power generation into investable projects aligned with Vision 2030. Rather than viewing efficiency solely as an engineering issue, the paper integrates evidence on heat-rate improvement, combined-cycle optimisation, digital operation and maintenance, auxiliary-load reduction, flexible generation, energy-performance contracting, green bonds, sukuk, and blended finance. A structured review of peer-reviewed literature from 2020 to 2025 links technical savings to risk allocation, cash-flow certainty, and cost of capital. The findings show that financing quality significantly affects the bankability of efficiency projects, as verified savings are often distributed across fuel, maintenance, reliability, and capacity benefits rather than consolidated in a single revenue stream. In Saudi Arabia, the most compelling near-term approach is to aggregate repeatable efficiency measures across generation portfolios, apply transparent baselines and performance guarantees, and connect refinancing to verified outcomes. The review concludes that energy efficiency should be considered productive infrastructure: a financing category that can reduce system costs, support renewable integration, conserve fuels, and improve the credibility of transition investments under Vision 2030.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】沙特阿拉伯的电力系统正在经历一场资本密集型的转型。在这一过程中，现有发电设施和新建发电项目的效率提升需要与可再生能源、电网、储能设施以及天然气基础设施的建设项目争夺资金支持。本文探讨了如何通过合理的融资设计，将技术上可行的能效改进方案转化为符合“2030愿景”（Vision 2030）的投资项目。文章并未将能效问题单纯视为一个工程学问题，而是综合分析了热效率提升、联合循环发电优化、数字化运营与维护、辅助负荷减少、灵活发电方式、能源绩效合同、绿色债券（green bonds）、伊斯兰债券（sukuk）以及混合融资（blended finance）等方面的相关证据。通过对2020年至2025年间发表的同行评审文献的系统性梳理，文章将技术节能效果与风险分配、现金流稳定性以及资本成本联系起来。研究结果表明，融资质量对能效项目的可行性具有显著影响——因为实际实现的节能效益往往分布在燃料成本、维护成本、系统可靠性以及发电容量等多个方面，而并非集中体现在单一的收入来源中。在沙特阿拉伯，短期内最可行的策略是将不同发电项目中的可重复能效改进措施进行整合，制定透明的基准和绩效保障措施，并将再融资安排...。

papers.title: The Digital Renminbi and China’s Rise to Global Financial Power – Lessons for Nigeria and Other Emerging Economies
papers.venue: International Journal of Economics and Financial Management
papers.abstract:
The rapid diffusion of digital payment platforms has reshaped the architecture of global 
finance, with China’s “super-apps” (e.g., WeChat Pay) and its state-issued digital renminbi 
(e-RMB) exemplifying a new model of cloud finance—the seamless integration of big-tech 
ecosystems with banking services under central regulatory control (Varoufakis, 2023). In 
contrast, Western economies rely on a fragmented network of private processors (Google Pay, 
Apple Pay) that retain a percentage of each transaction, reinforcing the intermediating role of 
traditional banks (Sachs, 2020). This study investigates how the convergence of cloud capital—
the economic value generated by ownership of data-driven platforms (Varoufakis, 2023)—and 
state-directed finance in China challenges the existing dollar-centric payment system and what 
implications this holds for emerging economies such as Nigeria. A mixed-methods approach 
was employed. Secondary data covering 2018-2025 were sourced from the Bank for 
International Settlements, International Monetary Fund Direction of Trade Statistics, World 
Bank Global Findex, and the People’s Bank of China, providing objective indicators of 
cross-border fees, settlement times, dollar-denominated trade shares, financial inclusion, and 
mobile-phone penetration. Primary data were collected via a structured questionnaire 
administered to 300 stakeholders (academics, international businessmen/investors, 
postgraduate students, and central-bank officials) in Nigeria, Kenya, and Brazil. The 
questionnaire used five-point Likert scales to capture latent constructs such as perceived 
efficiency of cloud finance, trust in the e-RMB, and adoption likelihood. After cleaning, 252 
valid responses remained. Reliability analysis yielded Cronbach’s α = 0.81 for the 
cloud-finance perception scale and α = 0.79 for the e-RMB perception scale, indicating 
acceptable internal consistency. Exploratory factor analysis confirmed the intended factor 
structure. Descriptive statistics revealed a mean perceived cloud-finance advantage of 
3.42 ± 0.71 and a mean e-RMB perception of 3.78 ± 0.68 on a 5-point scale. Correlation 
analysis showed significant negative associations between cloud-finance perception and 
average cross-border fees (r = –0.52, p < 0.01) and between e-RMB perception and the change 
in USD-denominated trade share (r = –0.44, p < 0.01). Ordinary least-squares regression 
(Model 1) demonstrated that a one-unit increase in cloud-finance perception reduces average 
cross-border fees by 0.14 percentage points (β = –0.14, p < 0.001) after controlling for age, 
education, and mobile penetration (R² = 0.38). A panel-corrected standard-error model 
(Model 2) indicated that higher e-RMB perception is associated with a 0.21 percentage-point decline in the USD share of trade (β = –0.21, p = 0.003), supporting the hypothesis that 
real-time settlement capability weakens dollar dominance (Prasad & Kaur, 2020).The findings 
confirm that China’s integrated cloud-finance model, anchored by the e-RMB, generates 
measurable efficiency gains and challenges the dollar-centric payment system. Stakeholders in 
emerging economies view the e-RMB as a strategic opportunity for enhancing financial 
inclusion and reducing external financial vulnerability (Onoh & Mbanasor, 2025). The study 
contributes to the literature on cloud capital (Varoufakis, 2023) and digital sovereign 
currencies (Nogueira Batista, 2020) by providing empirical evidence of their impact on global 
payment systems and offering a conceptual framework for emerging economies to develop 
cloud-capital capacities while mitigating sovereignty risks.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】数字支付平台的快速普及重塑了全球金融体系的架构。中国的“超级应用”（如微信支付）以及由政府发行的数字人民币（e-RMB）体现了云计算金融的新模式——即大型科技生态系统在中央监管下的与银行服务的无缝融合（Varoufakis, 2023）。相比之下，西方经济体依赖于由私人支付服务商（如谷歌支付、苹果支付）组成的分散网络，这些服务商会从每笔交易中抽取一定比例的费用，从而强化了传统银行的中介作用（Sachs, 2020）。本研究探讨了中国云计算资本（即数据驱动平台所创造的经济价值，Varoufakis, 2023）与政府主导的金融体系的融合如何挑战现有的以美元为中心的支付体系，以及这对尼日利亚等新兴经济体意味着什么。研究采用了混合方法：二手数据来源于国际清算银行、国际货币基金组织的贸易统计数据、世界银行的全球金融指数和中国人民银行，这些数据提供了跨境费用、结算时间、以美元计价的贸易份额、金融包容性和手机普及率的客观指标；一手数据则是通过对尼日利亚、肯尼亚和巴西的300位利益相关者（包括学者、国际商人和投资者、研究生以及央行官员）进行结构化问卷调查获得的。问卷使用了五点李克特量表来衡量受...。研究方法：回归分析。
